input.baseline: Fixed-pose integration before frame 4493 recovery; this diagnostic runs before recovery and rejects simultaneous recovery/BA flags.

policy.anchors: Left-only DLT with existing min-two, positive-depth, mean <= 2 px, max <= 4 px gates; no target-side poses used in anchor construction.
policy.candidate_application: One right-side rig frame at a time, diagnostic only; fixed sensor extrinsics recomposed. No pose propagation, automatic adoption, model output or observation pruning.

counts.counting_note: Attempts, successes and existing-landmark failures are summed over independent per-frame candidates; they are not unique track counts in a simultaneously updated model.

verification.full_workspace_local_tests: Attempt stopped by filesystem capacity; not a pass. Root subsequently removed only regenerable visloc-slam dev build artifacts with cargo clean --profile dev -p visloc-slam, recovering 7.3 GiB.
verification.timing_note: Use the archived /usr/bin/time wall value, not CPU time or an earlier run. Shared-machine integration/diagnostic-only pilot; not a mapper/E2E speed claim.

decision: Do not adopt the pose candidates. Next audit the hypothetical frame/landmark graph and support after adding full-cross successes and excluding failed existing tracks; two new cross tracks may merely move the split to the next frame. Keep the frozen COLMAP quality target and original scoring alignment.
